    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = max(set(v for row in g for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in g))
    coords = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(g) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != bg]
    by_color = {}

        by_color.setdefault(g[r][c], []).append((r, c))
    # The repeated color marks a diagonal ray; continue from the endpoint in its direction.
    candidates = [(color, pts) for color, pts in by_color.items() if len(pts) >= 2]
    color, pts = max(candidates, key=lambda item: len(item[1]))
    pts = sorted(pts)
    # Find the pair establishing a diagonal direction, then continue beyond the furthest point.
    pairs = []
    for i, (r1, c1) in enumerate(pts):
        for r2, c2 in pts[i+1:]:
            if abs(r2-r1) == abs(c2-c1) and r2 != r1:
                pairs.append((r1, c1, r2, c2))
    _, _, r2, c2 = max(pairs, key=lambda p: (p[2], p[0]))
    r1, c1 = next((p[0], p[1]) for p in pairs if p[2] == r2 and p[3] == c2)
    dr = 1 if r2 > r1 else -1
    dc = 1 if c2 > c1 else -1
    r, c = r2 + dr, c2 + dc
    while 0 <= r < len(g) and 0 <= c < len(g[0]):
        g[r][c] = color
        r += dr
        c += dc
    return g
